description: A line of a run's log.

kind.description: What it is: the script's output or errors, a line it said, an ask of its Bot, the Bot's answer, the run's state changing, or what a chat it started said as its first turn ended (told its Bot too).

values.description: An answer's values, from a form.

error.description: An ask's: it was an error handed over. An agent's: the chat failed, or was stopped.

over.description: An agent's: how the chat's turn ended (Sender's over).
